properties.name: Zalabesenyő
properties.method: Observed source free-cell lobes outside explicit annotation disc window, exact pixel-run union. Inside the window, shortest convex connection of source-interior entry intervals; reconstructed caps remain uncertain. No use of present-day roads/name points as boundary controls. Frozen inherited affine EOV then WGS84.
uncertaintyNotes: Observed pixels outside the annotation window retain the source contour. Reconstructed cap location inside the window is inferred and may differ from the unseen original line.
Alternatives displace each cap midpoint by up to ±3 source pixels, bounded by the annotation window; these illustrate local ambiguity and are not a statistical confidence interval.
The inherited affine has zero independent interior controls; perimeter fit residuals do not measure absolute interior accuracy.
